v1.6.0.title: Tournament Core Integration
features: Tournament Scoped by Event: tournaments are automatically scoped to the active event
Event Settings Toggle: enable/disable tournament feature per event via Event Settings
Guest Picker for Team Members: select existing guests from the event to join tournament teams
Tournament Stats & Calendar: tournaments count and badges now appear in the event calendar and dashboard
Team Logo Upload: support file uploads for team logos
Live Match Display: dedicated live route for displaying ongoing matches

v1.5.0.title: Guest Purge Synchronization & Dynamic Dashboard Background
features: Fixed SSE Guest Purge synchronization: automatic local cache invalidation on check-in and souvenir devices
Dynamic Dashboard Background: automatically syncs with event system settings (IMAGE/VIDEO)
Transparent Dashboard UI: enhanced glassmorphism and transparent root container
Manual Clear Cache: added manual cache clearing button in check-in settings
Souvenir cache awareness: souvenir page now listens for guest update events

v1.4.0.title: Multi-Station Offline Mode with Performance Optimizations
features: Multi-station check-in support with unique station identity
Offline mode: check-in continues without internet via IndexedDB queue
Auto-sync: automatic synchronization when connection restored (configurable interval)
Conflict resolution: first-wins strategy with duplicate flagging and audit trail
Queue management: view, retry, clear pending check-ins
Queue limit enforcement: warn at 80%, block at 100% (configurable)
Photo offline support: captured photos stored as base64 for later sync
Connection status indicator: real-time online/offline/queue status
Station setup modal: configure station name and offline settings
Health check endpoint: GET /api/public/health for connection monitoring
Distinct SSE 'sync_complete' event with station counts and conflict details
IndexedDB caching for offline guest data
fixes: Wire offline detection to doSearch, doCheckin, and QR scan flows
Queue limit enforcement prevents unbounded offline queue growth
Photo upload fallback: store base64 in IndexedDB when upload fails
Connection status auto-retry with exponential backoff
Health check timeout: AbortSignal.timeout(5s) prevents hanging requests
Sync_complete SSE event handler added to frontend
Sync conflict error messages propagated to queue panel
performance: syncBatchFromStation: batch load guests (2 queries vs N queries)
syncBatchFromStation: Promise.all for parallel check-in processing
checkInOffline: select instead of include (50% less data transfer)
getStationsByEvent: Prisma _count include (1 query vs N+1)
IndexedDB: Promise.all parallel updates for pending check-ins
IndexedDB: cursor-based batch delete for synced check-ins
IndexedDB: parallel cache updates for remote guest data
Connection health check: performance.now() for sub-millisecond precision

added: POST /api/stations/register - Register or update check-in station
GET /api/stations?eventId=xxx - List active stations with check-in counts
POST /api/public/guests/sync-batch - Bulk sync offline check-ins with conflict resolution
GET /api/public/health - Health check with offline configuration
